content.comment_body: It is likely that you are using a prepaid card without available credit.

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes that the [product_name] module is not sending SMS or email messages, even though it reports an active connection. Community feedback points toward a possible issue with insufficient credit on the prepaid SIM card. This highlights a lack of user notifications from the [product_name] regarding failed message deliveries.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] to send SMS and emails whenever a connection is indicated, and to receive clear notifications about any problems that prevent successful delivery of messages.
